mapper.select: SELECT a.ADJUSTMENT_ID, a.ADJUSTMENT_NO, a.MODEL_ID, a.PERIOD, a.VERSION, a.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE, a.ADJUSTMENT_REASON, a.ADJUSTMENT_DESC, a.STATUS, a.SUBMIT_USER, a.SUBMIT_TIME, a.APPROVE_USER, a.APPROVE_TIME, a.APPROVE_OPINION, a.EXECUTE_USER, a.EXECUTE_TIME, a.CREATE_USER, a.CREATE_TIME, m.MODEL_NAME, d.DETAIL_ID, d.DATA_ID, d.SUBJECT_CODE, d.SUBJECT_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_CODE, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DIMENSION1_CODE, d.DIMENSION1_NAME, d.DIMENSION2_CODE, d.DIMENSION2_NAME, d.ORIGINAL_VALUE, d.ADJUSTMENT_VALUE, d.ADJUSTED_VALUE, d.ADJUSTMENT_REASON as DETAIL_ADJUSTMENT_REASON FROM TBL_BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT a LEFT JOIN TBL_BUDGET_MODEL m ON a.MODEL_ID = m.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT_DETAIL d ON a.ADJUSTMENT_ID = d.ADJUSTMENT_ID WHERE a.ADJUSTMENT_ID = #{adjustmentId} ORDER BY d.CREATE_TIME ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as "totalCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "draftCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "submittedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "approvedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "rejectedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'EXECUTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "executedCount" FROM TBL_BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId}

SELECT CONCAT('ADJ', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), LPAD(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(ADJUSTMENT_NO, 12)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM TBL_BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND ADJUSTMENT_NO LIKE CONCAT('ADJ', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '%')
